item.title: Frankreichs Regierung nach gewaltsamen Wochenendprotesten unter Druck
item.description: In Frankreich herrscht politische Anspannung, nachdem Ausschreitungen Kundgebungen gegen die Lebenshaltungskosten und mangelhafte öffentliche Dienste überschattet haben.

item.title: Ishrak will Rücktritt nach Spekulationen und nächtlichen Dementis erklären
item.description: Nach Berichten über die Anweisung zum Rücktritt als Staatsminister für Befreiungskriegsfragen hatte Ishrak Hossain dies zunächst als Gerücht bezeichnet und die Nacht über Nachrichten veröffentlicht.

item.title: Assams Obergericht fordert Rückführung einer indischen Bürgerin aus Bangladesch
item.description: Im Mai war die Hausfrau Momtaj Begum von einem Ausländergericht in Nagaon in Polizeigewahrsam genommen und im Juni nach Bangladesch abgeschoben worden. Nun gab das Gericht erneut Anweisungen zu ihrer Rücknahme.

item.title: Bedenken zur Integrität der Wählerverifizierung bei Indiens Wahlen
item.description: Anfangs akzeptierte die Wahlkommission die Aadhaar-Karte nicht zur Identitätsprüfung von Wählern, da die Befürchtung bestand, dass das Dokument zusätzliche Personen einbeziehen könnte.

item.title: Wissenschaftliche Hintergründe zur Leitfähigkeit bestimmter Früchte und Gemüse
item.description: Kartoffelbatterien sind ein klassisches Projekt bei Wissenschaftsmessen, bei dem Kartoffeln genutzt werden, um kleine Glühbirnen zum Leuchten zu bringen. Es erstaunt viele Menschen, dass alltägliches Gemüse Strom leiten kann.

item.title: Bollywood-Schauspieler Tiger Shroff entgeht Anschlag in Mumbai
item.description: Auf Videoaufnahmen ist zu sehen, wie bewaffnete Angreifer Schüsse auf das Auto von Shroff abfeuerten, während es sich langsam durch eine Menschenmenge bewegte.

item.title: Aktuelle Wechselkurse laut Angaben der Zentralbank von Bangladesh
item.description: Gemäß den heute von der Bank of Bangladesh veröffentlichten Daten ist der US-Dollar leicht im Preis gestiegen. Der durchschnittliche Marktkurs liegt bei 123,65 Taka.

item.title: Ishrak droht der Verlust seines Ministeramtes nach Waffen-Video
item.description: Einen Tag nachdem ein Video in den sozialen Medien auftauchte, das ihn mit einer Schusswaffe zeigte, wurde er von Premierminister Tarique Rahman zum Rücktritt aufgefordert.

item.title: বিদ্যুৎস্পৃষ্ট হয়ে নারীর মৃত্যু, পরিবারের শোক
item.description: পূজা উদ্‌যাপনের সময় বিদ্যুৎস্পৃষ্ট হয়ে এক নারীর প্রাণহানি ঘটেছে। স্থানীয়দের অভিযোগ, রাতে তার ছেঁড়ার কথা জানালেও বিদ্যুৎ অফিস দ্রুত কোনো পদক্ষেপ নেয়নি।

item.description: তেল আবিব থেকে ভিয়েনাগামী অস্ট্রিয়ান এয়ারলাইনসের একটি বিমান বোমা হুমকির মুখে বুলগেরিয়ায় নামে। রোমানিয়া সীমান্তসংলগ্ন এলাকায় থাকাকালীন ক্রুরা এই হুমকি পান।

item.title: BUTEX opens master's admissions with exams set for December
item.description: Bangladesh University of Textiles begins accepting master's applications on October 25, followed by a 100-mark entrance exam on December 4. Each of the five faculties offers 15 seats per department.

item.title: French markets face sell-off amid unrest and rising bond yields
item.description: France experienced a drop in bonds and equities on Monday following intense demonstrations. The spread between French and German borrowing costs grew as President Macron criticized the unrest.

item.title: Unregulated resorts expand in Cox's Bazar amid official inaction
item.description: New hospitality venues like the Coral Beach Resort are being built in ecologically sensitive zones near Ukhia without proper oversight. Like earlier properties, these locations operate without basic fire safety compliance.

item.title: India defeats Zimbabwe to secure series victory
item.description: India achieved a comfortable win after restricting Zimbabwe to 102 runs for the loss of 8 wickets, backed by strong performances from Shafali and Mandhana.

item.title: New Delhi urges Meta to broaden narrative exposure on recommendation feeds
item.description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology directed Meta to evaluate its ranking algorithms. The advisory follows demonstrations calling for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: Nagpur Symbiosis professor suspended over messages sent to former pupil
item.description: An educator at Symbiosis in Nagpur was sent on leave following allegations of sending improper messages to an ex-student. The situation sparked demonstrations by ABVP and VHP members demanding his dismissal.

item.title: Police use lathi-charge during nomination scrutiny in Kuppam
item.description: Law enforcement deployed batons to disperse crowds during nomination reviews in Kuppam. Authorities increased security measures to halt further clashes between opposing TDP and YSRCP factions.

item.title: প্রধানমন্ত্রী ওসমানী উদ্যান ও জুলাই স্মৃতিস্তম্ভের উদ্বোধন করেন
item.description: রাজধানীর নাগরিক পরিবেশ উন্নত করতে এবং জুলাই অভ্যুত্থানের শহীদদের স্মৃতি ধরে রাখতে এই দুটি প্রকল্প বাস্তবায়ন করা হয়েছে। প্রধানমন্ত্রী আজ এর উদ্বোধন করেন।

item.title: Rubio highlights Trump's desire to conclude conflict amid Putin's plans
item.description: Marco Rubio reaffirmed Donald Trump's objective to bring the ongoing war to a close. This statement comes in connection with Vladimir Putin's upcoming summit proposal.

item.title: Sydney strip club owner loses appeal against entry ban
item.description: A New South Wales tribunal has confirmed a restriction stopping Manthos Papadopoulos from accessing designated high-risk nightlife spots, including his own adult entertainment businesses in Sydney.

item.title: Hindu community observes Durga Puja festivities
item.description: Hindus have marked their major religious celebration with traditional prayers, rituals, and offerings at various mandaps. The event fostered a festive environment filled with community harmony and enthusiasm.

item.title: Melbourne vegan cafe run by Indian-origin pair hit by arson
item.description: Ashish Sharma and Manali Purohit saw their newly launched Fitzroy North eatery, And Bodega, severely wrecked in an arson fire tied to a nearby tobacco shop, resulting in $100,000 in damages.

item.title: Advocates demand better healthcare access for countryside regions
item.description: Activists argue that people living in rural areas risk losing access to essential hospital care because their needs are frequently overlooked.

item.title: Kodak operated underground uranium research tool for decades
item.description: From 1975 until its closure in 2006, Kodak ran a uranium research device under a Rochester facility to check materials for flaws, a fact that drew public scrutiny in 2012 due to its enriched uranium.

item.title: বলিউড অভিনেতা টাইগার শ্রফের গাড়ির ঘটনায় মামলা
item.description: মুম্বাইয়ে অভিনেতা টাইগার শ্রফের গাড়িতে হামলার ঘটনায় অজ্ঞাত তিনজনের নামে মামলা হয়েছে। অপরাধীদের গ্রেফতারে ১৫টি দল কাজ করছে এবং একটি মোটরসাইকেল ও লরেন্স বিষ্ণোই চক্রের সংযোগ খতিয়ে দেখা হচ্ছে।

item.title: ডিজিটাল ব্যাংকিং নিয়ে আজিয়াটার মূল্যায়ন
item.description: বাংলাদেশ ও মালয়েশিয়ার অর্থনীতির আকার, বাজার বয়স, জনসংখ্যা ও ব্যয়ের সামর্থ্যের মধ্যে মৌলিক ফারাক রয়েছে। এই দুই ভিন্ন বাজারের ডিজিটাল ব্যাংকিং খাতে বড় সুযোগ দেখছে আজিয়াটা।

item.title: Reflections on the global impact of the Cuban Revolution
item.description: The Cuban Revolution has delivered complex contributions to the international community throughout its history. Observers note that its eventual collapse would represent a significant global absence.

item.title: UP: Two Charged for Assaulting Dalit Man at Ballia Temple
item.description: Two individuals face charges for allegedly beating and directing caste insults at a Dalit man on October 18 for visiting and praying at a temple in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Tarique Rahman Opens Dhaka July Memorial and Osmani Udyan
item.description: In Dhaka, Prime Minister Tarique Rahman opened the July Memorial on October 19 to honor uprising victims alongside relatives of four martyrs. He also unveiled the upgraded 23-acre Osmani Udyan.

item.title: Kota Police Detain Three Men Over Tiger Shroff Car Shooting
item.description: Authorities in Kota have taken three individuals into custody following a shooting incident targeting actor Tiger Shroff's vehicle on Sunday evening, October 18, 2026, in Mumbai's Juhu district.

item.title: Bus Passengers in England Face £100 Penalties for Loud Audio
item.description: Individuals playing loud audio on English buses risk receiving financial penalties under new guidelines. Concurrently, a fresh initiative is rolling out on rail networks urging travelers to be considerate of their noise levels.

item.title: Israeli Police Detain Eight Over West Bank Diplomat Attacks
item.description: Under 'Olive Leaf', Israeli law enforcement arrested eight individuals following assaults by settlers against a U.S. photojournalist and European diplomats in the West Bank.

item.title: Bogura National Citizen Party Office Torched Late Wednesday
item.description: The closed temporary district facility of the National Citizen Party in Bogura was burned down late Wednesday night. Footage capturing the event has spread across social media platforms.

item.title: Lawrence Bishnoi and Salman Khan's 1998 Blackbuck Feud
item.description: Gangster Lawrence Bishnoi's animosity toward actor Salman Khan stems from the historical 1998 blackbuck poaching incident.

item.title: Kushtia Shrine Bomb Found, Border Guard Units Deployed
item.description: Law enforcement found a time bomb and two petrol containers at Lalon's shrine in Kushtia during the early hours of Monday. Following the 1:30 AM discovery, the area was secured and BGB personnel were dispatched.

item.title: Fadnavis Vows Action After Mumbai Shooting Targeting Shroff
item.description: Devendra Fadnavis stated that perpetrators and coordinators behind the gunfire targeting Tiger Shroff's car will face consequences, noting potential local involvement within Maharashtra.

item.title: flydubai Indian Pilot Questions Plumber's Claims of Landing Plane
item.description: An Indian pilot working for flydubai has expressed skepticism over statements made by Hayoun. The plumber previously claimed he entered the cockpit, subdued the co-pilot, and took charge of the aircraft.

item.title: সিজেপির দাবি, সৌরভ ও রাঙ্কার জামিন শুনানিতে ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট দেরিতে আসেন
item.description: নির্ধারিত দুপুর ১২টার পরিবর্তে বিশেষ নির্বাহী ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট ও সরকারি কৌঁসুলি বিকেল ৫টায় আদালতে উপস্থিত হন। সিজেপির নেতারা এই বিলম্ব নিয়ে প্রশ্ন তুলেছেন।

item.title: Strains Emerge in Alliance Between Washington and Tel Aviv
item.description: Recent developments indicate a growing diplomatic divide between the United States and Israel. Observers note increasing friction in their historically close bilateral ties.

item.title: Bollywood Security Concerns Resurface After Attack on Tiger Shroff
item.description: An assault on actor Tiger Shroff has revived anxieties regarding the safety of film industry figures. Observers draw parallels to past decades when criminal syndicates heavily influenced Mumbai cinema.

item.title: Greek Locals in Athens Upset Over Rising Israeli Property Investments
item.description: In the Exarchia neighborhood of Athens, locals report that short-term rentals are altering the community's identity. Residents attribute surging housing costs to an influx of Israeli property buyers.

item.title: An Se-young Claims Record 47th Title at Denmark Open
item.description: Defeating Akane Yamaguchi in the Denmark Open final, An Se-young secured her 47th international title. This victory breaks Susi Susanti's 29-year-old record of 46 titles.

item.title: White House Denies Internal Chaos Amid Media Reports
item.description: Reports of dysfunction surrounding Zacharia's brief time in office have circulated in the media. Administration representatives maintain that allegations of internal turmoil are overstated.

item.title: Shashi Tharoor Criticizes Central Government Over Nobel Winner Silence
item.description: Politician Shashi Tharoor condemned the central authorities for failing to acknowledge Nobel Peace Prize recipient Navi Pillay. Pillay is a South African jurist of Tamil heritage and a former UN human rights chief.

item.title: Manipur: One killed in Thoubal violence as curfew is enacted
item.description: Authorities instituted stay-at-home restrictions across two local zones following violent clashes that left one person dead and multiple injured. Arson attacks also damaged several properties and automobiles in the area.

item.title: Kuki organization calls for major Manipur highway shutdown
item.description: Following recent village assaults, a Kuki association has declared a blockade on a vital Manipur roadway. Concurrently, the regional administration relocated the Kamjong district police chief.

item.title: Equities recover most morning drops driven by Reliance and SBI
item.description: Indian shares erased initial steep declines bolstered by purchase activity in firms like Reliance Industries and SBI. Meanwhile, major equities such as HDFC Bank and Infosys registered notable declines.

item.title: বন্ধুদের উদ্যোগে শিশুদের মধ্যে দুর্গাপূজার উপহার বিতরণ
item.description: ধর্মীয় বিভেদ ভুলে সম্প্রীতি ও ভালোবাসার মাধ্যমে শান্তিপূর্ণ বাংলাদেশ গড়ার প্রত্যয়ে শিশুদের হাতে দুর্গাপূজার উপহার তুলে দিয়েছেন বন্ধুরা। উৎসবে এই আনন্দ সবার মাঝে ছড়িয়ে দেওয়াই এর মূল উদ্দেশ্য।

item.title: Maharashtra woman rises from farm laborer to run 12-acre farm
item.description: Sunita Nehare of Pachod village evolved from earning daily wages to overseeing her household's 12-acre agricultural land. By modernizing farming techniques, she significantly improved harvest outputs despite initial setbacks.

item.title: Shashi Tharoor criticizes central government over Navi Pillay
item.description: Shashi Tharoor publicly rebuked the central administration for remaining silent regarding Navi Pillay receiving a Nobel Prize, calling out authorities over the lack of official acknowledgment.

item.title: Varanasi: Four taking selfies on bridge die in SUV-truck crash
item.description: An accident involving a truck and an SUV in Varanasi claimed the lives of four individuals who were taking selfies on an overbridge. Authorities identified three victims as Aman Yadav, Golu Yadav, and Alok Mishra, while two others remain critical.

item.title: মুদ্রণ ও প্রকাশনা অধিদপ্তরে ২১ পদের নিয়োগ পরীক্ষার সূচি প্রকাশ
item.description: দীর্ঘ তিন বছর পর মুদ্রণ ও প্রকাশনা অধিদপ্তরের ১৩ থেকে ২০ গ্রেডের ২১টি ক্যাটাগরির পদের নিয়োগ পরীক্ষার সময়সূচি ঘোষণা করা হয়েছে। এর মাধ্যমে পদগুলোতে নিয়োগের প্রক্রিয়া শুরু হচ্ছে।

item.title: Macron condemns unbridled unrest during French protests
item.description: French leader Emmanuel Macron criticized the severe violence and looting during Sunday cost-of-living rallies in Paris. Law enforcement detained nearly 2,400 individuals following the disturbances on October 18.

item.title: Putin suggests three-way meeting with Trump and Xi
item.description: According to a Wall Street Journal report on Sunday, Vladimir Putin suggested holding a summit next month with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The proposed talks aim to address the four-year Ukraine war with terms beneficial to Moscow.
